title: Guo Xi paints Old Trees, Level Distance
summary: Guo Xi’s landscape handscroll sets tall foreground trees against an open river valley, using ink and color on silk.

citations.locator: Object 1981.276; Date, Medium and proposed retirement occasion

claims.text: Guo Xi’s landscape handscroll sets tall foreground trees against an open river valley, using ink and color on silk.
The catalogue dates the painting to about 1080; the year is approximate.
The Met reads its autumnal mood as possibly connected to an official’s retirement. That proposed occasion remains an interpretation, not a documented commission.

review.corroboration: The Met object record was compared with its landscape-painting essay’s caption. Both are one institution; independent confirmation of the proposed occasion is absent.
